products.title: The cream knit layer
products.imageAlt: Cream knit poncho with a fringed hem on a wooden hanger
products.description: A neutral knit is an easy starting point for a relaxed wardrobe. This sample edit explores a light, textured layer for slow mornings and casual afternoons.
products.styling: Try a cream knit over a simple tank with straight-leg denim. Add a structured bag for a little contrast.

products.title: The everyday shoulder bag
products.imageAlt: Structured handbag with a chain strap
products.description: A structured silhouette brings a polished touch to the simplest outfit. This sample is a mood-board idea for finding your everyday companion.
products.styling: Pair a structured bag with a relaxed shirt and denim. Keep the rest of your accessories simple so the shape stands out.

products.title: The statement floral heel
products.imageAlt: Blue pointed-toe floral heels on a pale blue background
products.description: For the days that call for a little color. This sample edit takes its inspiration from a vivid floral pattern and a pointed-toe silhouette.
products.styling: Let a patterned shoe be the focus with a solid-color dress or cropped black trousers. Pull one color from the print into your accessories.

products.title: The jewel-tone earring
products.imageAlt: Blue jewel-tone statement earrings photographed on a green leaf
products.description: An expressive detail that changes the mood of an outfit. This sample edit is all about rich color, light-catching shapes, and a little occasion dressing.
products.styling: Wear statement earrings with an open neckline and tucked-back hair. A simple blouse gives the color room to shine.
